tables.description: What must be true on a construction site, independent of any legal system. The heart of the catalogue, and the file most contributors will extend.
Everything the detector can be asked to look for, with the five physical parameters that decide whether it could have been seen.
Generic stages of construction. Requirements bind to these; projects map their own phases onto them.
Kinds of works a requirement may be scoped to.
The legal systems for which a profile exists or is planned.
The seven ways a requirement can be settled, and what silence means under each.
How much of a requirement the machine may settle alone.
Shorthand for the pixel demand an object class implies.
Every constant the reasoner is tuned with, in one file rather than in code.
The instruments a profile draws on. One row per law, decree or standard.
The claim that this jurisdiction grounds this requirement in this clause. The file that makes CIEO portable.
This project's actual programme, each phase declaring which generic stages it realises.
